design_description: A bold pink-and-black design built on the “Fracture” template, combining disruptive textures with a vibrant, high-energy identity. Jagged vertical tear patterns, shattered geometric fragments, and distressed overlays create a dynamic surface that feels raw and constantly in motion. The bright pink base contrasts sharply with the black fracture streaks, giving the jersey a fearless and instantly recognizable appearance. Black collar, sleeve cuffs, and numbering provide clean structure, while the monochrome crest stands out against the chaotic background. Overall, the design feels modern, rebellious, and full of personality — a striking interpretation of the Fracture template.
